v.title: Wirtz’s Liverpool Glow: Klopp’s Pep and Iraola’s Trust Fuel a New Era
v.excerpt: Wirtz says Klopp’s faith and Iraola’s trust have made his Liverpool stint the best yet – a confidence boost that could reshape Barcelona’s attack.
v.body:
## Quick take
Florian Wirtz says the confidence from Klopp and Iraola has turned his Liverpool stint into the best period of his career yet – a boost that could ripple back to Barça’s ambitions.

## What happened
During a BBC interview, Wirtz revealed how Klopp’s relentless belief in him has reshaped his mindset. He credits the German coach’s tactical freedom and positive reinforcement for unlocking a new level of creativity and composure on the ball.

Back in Barcelona, Iraola’s trust has been equally transformative. By giving Wirtz a consistent role in the attacking midfield, the coach has allowed the German to thrive, turning him into a key playmaker for the Catalan giants.

## Why it matters
- **Barcelona’s creative core**: With Wirtz’s newfound confidence, Barça can finally field a midfield that balances defensive solidity with explosive attack. This could be the missing piece in their title push, especially against rivals who lack a similar spark.
- **Player development narrative**: Wirtz’s experience under Klopp shows that a supportive environment can accelerate growth. If Barcelona mirrors this model, it could accelerate the integration of young talents like Pedri and Gavi, keeping the squad competitive.
- **Seasonal trajectory**: The boost in Wirtz’s performance coincides with Barcelona’s need for consistency in La Liga and the Champions League. A player who feels ‘the best he’s ever felt’ can lift team morale, turning tight games into victories.

## What's next
Watch the upcoming La Liga clash against Real Madrid. Wirtz will be the linchpin in Barça’s attack, and his confidence could translate into decisive moments. Pay attention to his movement off the ball, his ability to link midfield and attack, and how he capitalises on the space created by the new tactical setup. A strong showing here could signal a turning point in Barcelona’s season.

*Source: [Klopp advice and Iraola confidence boosts Wirtz](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c69w91k0j9zeo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)*
